assessments.reasoning: The release tag resolves directly to the supplied immutable repository commit, whose tree authenticates the README blob. The publisher's release announcement confirms the version. README lines 7–17 identify Ruby as an interpreted, object-oriented programming language and describe language features including classes, methods and object behavior where all values are objects.

challenge.method: Distinguish the versioned Ruby source distribution, the language named by the README, Ruby implementations marketed under related names, and any external specification.
challenge.results: The released project explicitly defines the subject as a programming language and describes language features. The release source authenticates the project scope, while a claim about all Ruby implementations or ISO conformance would extend beyond it.

limitations: The subject is the language as described by Ruby's project at this release. The tag and release announcement fix the evidence version.
